newsitem.title: USA: ValuJet sees traffic building in late Nov.
newsitem.headline: ValuJet sees traffic building in late Nov.

text.p: ValuJet Inc President Lewis Jordan said on Tuesday that he expected the discount carrier's November load factor to be in the high 40s to low 50s.
Speaking to reporters in a conference call, he said ValuJet experienced light traffic so far this month but expected heavier travel around the Thanksgiving holiday in the United States.
"For November, we're in a very light period," said Jordan. "We are expecting somewhere in the range of the high 40s to the low 50s for a load factor for this month."

When asked about a load in the high 60 percent range for November 1995, the ValuJet executive said the airline's pre-crash operations had better momentum and that many of last year's passengers had booked their flights during the summer. This past summer, ValuJet was grounded.
"It's one more facet of our need to work out from under the period of the grounding," he said.

"We had been gradually adding aircraft over a consistent period of time, without the particular competitive environment that is being seen out there right now. We're seeing a lot of activity directed particularly at ValuJet."
